The v1.1.0 workflow validated the packages but failed during artifact upload, so no release was published. This release fixes uploads from the hidden .releases directory and publishes the same mod collection.

## Changes since v1.0.1

- Added Item Spawner Search Box (1.0.2): cross-category name/section search, synchronized list/grid results, result count, and Home shortcut protection.
- Combined sprint lowering, position profiles, and key/wheel stance controls in Lowered Weapon Sprint Extended (1.0.0).
- Combined both standalone positioning patches into MCM UI Tweaks (1.0.0), with two tabs and migration of existing offsets.
- Added AUG A1 3DSS, automatic mask wiping, faction-name randomization, NiS XML/faction-relations fixes, vanilla options improvements, and Load Ready Lite since the previous collection tag.
- Added per-mod MO2 metadata validation and verified individual ZIP packaging. Corrected README links, package-version formatting, and generated-file ignore rules.

## Installation and migration

Install only the desired mod ZIPs in MO2 and follow each mod's README in the repository for requirements and conflict priority. ZIP roots contain `meta.ini` and `gamedata/`; documentation remains in the repository.

Disable the two old standalone MCM position patches when using MCM UI Tweaks. Disable separate Lowered Weapon Key/Scroll Stance and older sprint/position copies when using the combined Lowered Weapon Sprint Extended. The full R1nk1/Crispy Load Ready variant has been removed from the current collection; Load Ready Lite is the notification-only alternative.

## Validation and limitations

Packaging tests, metadata/catalogue consistency, local README links, XML structure and duplicate string IDs, archive contents and CRC integrity are checked locally. In-game behavior and compatibility with a full modpack remain unverified for this release. No local Lua 5.1 compiler was available for a fresh syntax check. Existing third-party restrictions and incomplete asset/audio provenance noted in individual READMEs still apply.
